List and change Inbox rules (Outlook)

Usage:
  maildo rules [command]

Examples:
maildo rules list
maildo rules view rule-id
maildo rules create --subject-contains invoice --move-to Archive

Available Commands:
  create      Create an Inbox rule
  delete      Delete an Inbox rule
  disable     Turn an Inbox rule off
  enable      Turn an Inbox rule on
  health      Check Inbox rules for problems
  list        List Inbox rules
  update      Change an Inbox rule; a condition you give replaces its old values
  view        Show one Inbox rule

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for rules

Global Flags:
      --config string   Path to the config file
      --dry-run         Preview changes without performing them
      --json            Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi         Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color        Disable color in human output
      --no-pager        Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt       Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet           Suppress non-essential output

Use "maildo rules [command] --help" for more information about a command.
